name: UPS
author: kyonax
description: The desk UPS in the Omarchy bar: mains or battery, the countdown to the clean shutdown, load and battery, whether the PC is protected, the outage log, and the beeper, battery-test and shutdown controls.

barWidget.description: Mains or battery at a glance; readings, protection, outages and UPS controls in the popup.

schema.label: Bar label on mains
schema.description: What sits next to the icon while on mains. On battery the bar always shows the countdown to the clean shutdown.
